description: Per-system architecture atlas document — one file per tracked system boundary, authored inside docs/architecture/systems/. Carries two distinct clocks per the two-clock split (atlas-watch-script-convention.md): last_mapped (survey clock, full bootstrap only) and last_attested (targeted audit clock, on-diff passes). Produced by /architecture-survey (both clocks) and /architecture-audit (last_attested only). Spec backlink: docs/wiki/canonical-artifact-shapes.md § Atlas documents.

last_mapped.description: Date of the last full atlas re-bootstrap that wrote this file (YYYY-MM-DD). Survey clock — updated only by full /architecture-survey passes, never by targeted audits.

mode.description: Description of the run mode that produced this file. Free-form; for observability only.

last_attested.description: Date of the last targeted on-diff audit for this system (YYYY-MM-DD). Targeted-audit clock — updated by /architecture-audit but NOT by full /architecture-survey passes. Absent on files never targeted. Distinct from last_mapped — do NOT conflate.

system.description: System name this document covers. Matches the filename stem (e.g. 'coordinator-pipeline' for coordinator-pipeline.md).
